title: Show that every width on the length-8 cycle meets the touching diameter
body:
## Summary
- On the length-8 cycle, every width from 1 through 4 and every proper arc has Schur bandwidth equal to the diameter of the survivors that meet the arc. Widths 3 and 4 were the remaining neighbor counts.
- Deleting one vertex at width 3 leaves bandwidth 4 and entry `-1/144`, with inverse norms `27/14` inside the bounds `2` and `14`. At width 4 the same deletion leaves entry `-15/196` and inverse norms `28/15`, inside `2` and `18`.
- The selected κ is unchanged.
